title: Boardroom Ops Brief and Follow-ups
content:
Purpose: quick, tactical read for boardroom exec sync (30m). Focus: 1) operational risks that need cross-functional sign-off, 2) two ask items for budget/heads, 3) decisions on fallback routing policy for Dedicated outages. Tone: concise bullets + clear action owners.

Topline snapshot (30s):
- Hosting: 99.95% infra SLO last 7d, one regional disruption (us-west-2) — impact: ~6% request loss to Dedicated customers for 18m.
- Cost: LLM token spend up 12% month-over-month; Optimize recommendations show potential 18% unit-cost reduction if we apply quantization profiles to 35% of workloads.
- Product: Private pipeline validation complete for v0.9, scheduled pilot with AcmeCorp next week.

Agenda (30m total):
1) Incident recap + immediate mitigations (5m) — SRE lead summary + ask for approving temporary capacity burst in us-west-2.
2) Cost reduction proposal (8m) — Product + Finance present Optimize plan and tradeoffs (latency vs cost).
3) Private pilot status + data governance checklist (7m) — Solutions eng to confirm KMS/HSM readiness.
4) Rollout gating for new fallback routing (7m) — Ops to get approval on policy thresholds.

Key questions we need from boardroom: (prep answers below)
- Approve one-time $120k spend for reserve burst capacity (est 2 weeks) to cover predicted Dedicated risk window? (Yes/No)
- Accept phased quantization rollout (start with low-latency tolerant workloads) or require a full eval first?

Prep answers/data (so we can be decisive):
- Why burst $120k? breakdown: $80k reserved GPU pool 2 weeks; $20k cross-region egress; $20k ops overhead. Without burst, projected SLA credits to customers could exceed $300k (est). Source: RR-4821 incident model.
- Quantization risk matrix: expected 10–20ms median latency increase for some models; cost reduction 18% on tokens. Proposed mitigations: A/B compare with canary traffic, rollback knob in Console.

Open items / parking lot (not for board time unless asked):
- Need legal signoff on data residency text for AcmeCorp pilot (assigned to Marta).
- Follow-up: detailed per-model perf matrix for quantized variants (assigned to Applied ML).

Action tracker (clear owners, short deadlines):
- Approve temporary burst budget and provision capacity — Owner: CFO (Aisha Kumar) — Due: 2026-03-15.
- Ops to draft fallback routing policy doc for signoff — Owner: Tom Nguyen — Due: 2026-03-14.
- Solutions eng to confirm KMS integration and provide pilot checklist — Owner: Marta Reyes — Due: 2026-03-16.
- Applied ML to run quantization regression suite on the 10 highest-traffic models — Owner: Priya Desai — Due: 2026-03-18.
- Communications: Draft customer outreach template in case of Dedicated disruptions — Owner: Marketing (Samir) — Due: 2026-03-14.

Notes to self / talking bullets for the meeting:
- Emphasize tradeoff: short-term spend prevents outsized SLA credit risk and protects enterprise confidence.
- Quantization is not one-size-fits-all; propose a measured rollout with rollback guardrails.
- Private pilot is a strategic win for regulated customers; highlight KMS and audit logs readiness.

Risks and mitigations (one-liners):
- Risk: burst capacity delays due to procurement -> Mitigation: use cloud vendor express procurement + pre-authorize via legal.
- Risk: regressions in output quality from quantized models -> Mitigation: holdout evals and QA gates before traffic ramp.

Follow-up cadence: Quick sync call Monday 09:00 PT if board approves burst; otherwise skip.

Draft p2 email to execs after meeting (short):
Subject: Boardroom Ops Recap + Action Items (burst budget decision needed)\Body: TL;DR of decisions, list of owners + due dates, link to full incident model (CONFLUENCE-BOARD-OPS-6), request one-line approvals by EOD.

Quick references / links to bring into meeting:
- Incident model & cost projection: CONFLUENCE-BOARD-OPS-6
- RR incident ticket: RR-4821
- Quantization PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/912
- Slack thread with initial customer impact notes: slack://thread?team=T12345&id=F67890

Misc scratch:
- If CFO pushes back on spend, propose 50% immediate + 50% contingent on next-day telemetry.
- Bring up Dedicated SLA credits threshold so board understands financial exposure.

End of notes.

-- Jordan (quick edits welcome; will publish final brief if we get signoffs)
